resources.string: Decks with a time budget are studied with RWKV-Instant. Cards with the lowest predicted recall are shown first, including cards that are not due yet, until the day\'s time is used up. Answers are still scheduled by FSRS.
Max reviews per card per day
A card answered this many times today is not shown again today.
Cards below this predicted recall are shown even after the time is used up.
Only cards below this predicted recall are shown. The session ends early when none are left.
The minimum DR can\'t be higher than the maximum DR.
These apply to all enabled decks.
Choose which cards are shown first. Reviews are shown lowest predicted recall first; new cards follow the deck\'s order, and are only shown while time is left.
Stop showing new cards once the daily new card limit of the deck (or a subdeck) is reached. Otherwise new cards are only limited by time.
